# @nocopypaste/vue-grid

> A Vue 3 data grid laid out with CSS Grid and `subgrid`. A plain grid is a read-only table (16.5 kB gzip); sorting, filtering, server data, pagination, selection, sub-grids, menus, column pinning / reordering / resizing / visibility / groups, pinned rows, totals, row grouping (also on the server), inline cell editing with undo / redo, spreadsheet-like cell-range selection (copy, paste, fill handle, find and replace, delete and cut, sum), CSV and Excel export, printing, copying, a status bar, row reordering by drag and keyboard, test hooks on rows and cells (`row-attrs` / `cell-attrs`), virtual scrolling of rows and of columns, and keyboard navigation are opt-in features, and 29 cell renderers are opt-in imports. Every built-in text is translatable (`messages`), with ready-made language packs (`@nocopypaste/vue-grid/locales/de`, `fr`, `es`, `sr`, `sr-Latn`), and every piece a feature adds can be turned off (`parts`). Typed end to end, accessible, themeable with CSS variables, mobile and touch ready.

Read AGENTS.md first: it lists the rules that cause silent bugs when skipped (register features, pass renderer definitions, `sort-mode="client"`, bounded height), a "which feature for what" table and copy-paste recipes. Validate a grid config with `validateGridConfig()` from `@nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/AGENTS.md): rules, feature and renderer choice, recipes, pitfalls — start here
- [API reference](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent/api.md): every prop, v-model, event, slot, method, column option, feature and renderer option (generated from the sources)
- [README](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/README.md): each area in depth (filtering, server data, sub-grids, virtual scrolling, theming, browser support)
- [Live examples](https://eboye.github.io/eboye-vue-grid/): every feature running, each page with its complete source

## Machine-readable

- [api.json](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent/api.json): the API reference as JSON
- [grid-config.schema.json](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent/grid-config.schema.json): JSON Schema of a grid config (props + columns + features)
- `import { api, validateGridConfig } from '@nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent'`: the same, plus a validator that explains each problem and its fix

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://unpkg.com/@nocopypaste/vue-grid/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md + API reference + README in one file
- MCP server: `npx -y @nocopypaste/vue-grid-mcp` (tools: guide, API lookup, renderer details, doc search, config validation)
- Claude Code plugin (MCP server + skill): `/plugin install vue-grid --marketplace https://github.com/eboye/eboye-vue-grid`
